method: GP29 q13 arbitrary accepted-output deletion plus at most two arbitrary phase skips; necessary relaxation of <=2 strict adjacent-repeat retries
interpretation: No >=75%-visible embedding of the four q13 source cribs survives even a necessary relaxation permitting arbitrary accepted-output deletions and up to two unconstrained key-phase skips. Any real q13 GP29 strict-repeat sender occurrence of these cribs at this visibility floor must therefore incur at least three rejected key draws before the m-th retained rune. The conclusion is conditional on these source cribs/q13 and does not constrain unrelated plaintext.
